title: Yaw MCP CLI configuration (.yaw-mcp/config.json)
description: Configuration file for the @yawlabs/mcp CLI (bin `yaw-mcp`), which loads MCP servers from your local ~/.yaw-mcp/bundles.json. Resolved in precedence order (most-specific to least-specific): <project>/.yaw-mcp/config.local.json  >  <project>/.yaw-mcp/config.json  >  ~/.yaw-mcp/config.json. The project `.yaw-mcp/` directory is found by walking up from the current directory -- stopping just before $HOME when started under it; a directory outside $HOME walks to the filesystem root with an ownership check. JSONC (comments) is permitted.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema, enabling IDE autocomplete in editors that honor $schema.

version.description: Config schema version. Current version: 1. A value newer than the CLI understands triggers a warning but is not fatal.

token.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. yaw-mcp is local-only and no longer contacts a hosted API, so nothing reads this key. Delete it from your config, and revoke the PAT at its source -- deleting it here does not deactivate it. The property is retained (and its `mcp_pat_` pattern relaxed) only because this schema sets additionalProperties:false: removing it would mark every existing user config invalid.

apiBase.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. yaw-mcp is local-only and no longer contacts a hosted API. Delete it from your config. Retained for the same additionalProperties:false reason as `token`.

installNudge.description: Opt in to the shadow-driven install nudge in `discover`: when a recent shell command is shadowed by an MCP server you have not installed, discover suggests it. Off unless explicitly true. Resolved most-specific-scope-wins (local > project > global). The YAW_MCP_INSTALL_NUDGE=1 environment variable enables it independently.

servers.description: Allow-list of server namespaces to activate. If set in any scope, only these servers are active. Precedence: local scope wins over project, which wins over global (most-specific overrides).

blocked.description: Deny-list of server namespaces that are never activated. Merged as a union across all scopes (additive, not overriding).
